signal_description: Both images show four rail signals; only the 3rd from left is green, others red. B adds an arrow pointing toward the green 3rd signal.
basis: A and B independently mark position 3 of 4. In ID order (P1-P4) that is P3; in listed order (P3,P1,P2,P4) it is P2. Either is non-client-correct (P4 is). Matching signals suggest coordination, but shared intent is not established.
